svg.text: PART A - which heart (slot) and which pixel of it is the scan beam on?
PART B - heart lit? shape ROM, colour, output registers
Fig 12 - Health HUD: 2 x 20 hearts in the 160 px strip right of the maze
Hearts are 8 x 8 px, so slot = dx[7:3] and pixel-in-heart = dx[2:0] are pure wiring (no divider). P1 row at y = 32..39, P2 row at y = 432..439, strip x = 480..639.
HUD geometry (change constants to move it)
strip x = 480 .. 639 (160 px = 20 slots x 8 px)
unsigned subtract + one '<' compare tests both edges (as in Fig 9).
Tags in_x / in_p1 / in_p2 / slot / px / py are the same nets in Part B.
(Drawn as labels to avoid long crossing wires.)
hearts lit = first hp slots (hp = 20 -> all lit)
in_hud = in_x & (in_p1 | in_p2); 1 FF delay = ROM latency
8 x 8 x 1 bit, one shape for both players
sync read: shape bit 1 clk later
A slot inside the strip always draws (empty = grey heart), so the player sees the lost health.
Priority in the mixer: HUD is the highest (Fig 10), so hearts are never covered.
